format: UCWDC contests, randomization of each division's contestants

source.quote_free_summary: Each division's contestants 'must be randomized by the scoring system' to ensure fairness in access to the arena floor; contestants staying on the floor between heats should retire to the back and await entry from the randomized list.

requirement: A UCWDC profile must randomize each division's contestants in the scoring system, with a reproducible record: recorded seed, algorithm version, final assigned order and audit evidence (coordinate with OD-10 and OD-07 evidence rules).
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body's scoring profile. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: planner, SQL, UI changes.
interpretation_notes: 'must be randomized' is mandatory; the retire-to-the-back instruction is 'should', advisory and operational (Emcee), not a system requirement. Reproducible randomization design: record seed and algorithm version at generation, store the final order, treat any re-draw as an audited new version, and never shuffle after publication. The existing heatPlanner records a seed and engine version but is not a UCWDC implementation (OD25-DF-0002).
decision_refs: OD-25 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B now for Studio/Custom heat planning; Option A for future body profiles; retrospective audit PR #795)
